text: An octagonal gazebo stands at the center of the bluehouse. Someone in white holds out a hand from an ivory chair and waits for the party to come closer.

views.text: A gray, emaciated woman sits among scattered bones. A pearl necklace is the one beautiful thing left on her, and her outstretched hand is an invitation that feels like a trap.
An elegant woman in white silk rests in an ivory gazebo. Rose petals surround her chair as she offers a graceful hand and waits for a courtly greeting.
